Ichijou"Hah! Such big talk, and now your hands are on leave?!"
Raichou"…………"
Ichijou"Same story with all of you. Your only talent is making other people work under your shitty authority. Alone, you can't do one damn thing."
Ichijou"Useless! DIE! MASAMUNE!"
